description: Verify the configured Jira credentials by fetching the authenticated account. Returns ok, the site base_url, and the service account's id and display name. Read action.
embedding_description: Confirm that the jira_plugin is correctly configured and can authenticate — fetches the currently authenticated Atlassian account and returns ok, the resolved site base_url, and the service account's account id and display name. Use this as a health check after registering or rotating credentials to confirm the token works and points at the expected site, before relying on the other verbs. Distinct from get_issue (fetch a ticket) and jql_search (find tickets).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: ok flag, the site base_url, and the authenticated account's id and display name.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm connectivity and echo the base_url and account so the operator can verify the plugin points at the expected site and service account.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: jira.auth_failed: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked. jira.not_configured: the jira_site address-book entry is missing or incomplete. jira.api_error: the site is unreachable or returned an unexpected error.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: jira.auth_failed: rotate the API token (mint a fresh one, agent-blind vault re-store of jira_api_token, update expires_at) per the overview runbook. jira.not_configured: register the jira_site entry.
